title: Locusts and Other Transboundary Plant Pests and Diseases - Visual Identity & Brochure
shortDescription: Comprehensive editorial publication and circular geometric cover system highlighting the global mandate and rapid-response architecture of FAO’s Transboundary Plant Pests and Diseases team.
mandateChallenge: Unify diverse global plant health emergencies - Desert Locust, Fall Armyworm, Banana Fusarium Wilt - under a cohesive, modern visual system.
executionCraft: Designed in Adobe InDesign and Illustrator with custom circular composite framing, infographics, and 3D presentation mockups.
impactMetric: Global Donor Briefing Standard · FAO NSPMD
